## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `meter`. One of `meter`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The meter's id. |
| `data.name` | `string` | The meter's name. |
| `data.event_name` | `string` | The event name it reads. |
| `data.aggregation` | `string` | How events combine in a period. `avg` = total of the values ÷ number of events. `unique` counts distinct values of `unique_property`. `weighted_sum` bills a level × the time it held. One of `sum`, `count`, `min`, `max`, `avg`, `last`, `unique`, `weighted_sum`. |
| `data.value_property` | `string` | The property holding the number. Required except for `count`. |
| `data.unique_property` | `string` | `unique` only: the property whose distinct values are counted. |
| `data.recurring` | `boolean` | sum, last, max and unique only: the level carries into the next period. |
| `data.time_unit` | `string` | `weighted_sum` only. One of `hour`, `day`. |
| `data.filters` | `object` | An event counts only when every listed property has one of its values. |
| `data.group_by` | `array of string` | Up to 5 property names, in order. A price can set a rate for each combination. |
| `data.limit_dimensions` | `array of string` | Up to 3 event properties a spend limit can name (`property_key`), so each value of the property has its own limit. Can change after the meter has usage. |
| `data.price_list` | `object` | Maps each combination to a model price list key, for `model_price_list` prices and line cost. Each key it reads must be in `group_by`. Can change after the meter has usage. |
| `data.cost_currency` | `string` | The currency of event `cost` for events that name none. Null = the price's currency. |
| `data.status` | `string` | The meter's status. One of `active`, `archived`. |
| `data.locked` | `boolean` | True once the meter has a counted event or a price: only `name` can change. |
| `data.created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the meter was created (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.updated_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the meter was last changed (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.resource_version` | `integer` | A number that goes up on every change. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Pass as `starting_after` to get the next page. Null on the last page. |
